Rationale.RP1_ImplementationReconstructability: The experiment can be reconstructed from plan.md and CodeWalkthrough.md. The plan documents the ELM method, expected WMDP accuracy ranges (Bio: 29.7-33.7%, Cyber: 26.6-28.2%), HuggingFace model usage, and evaluation methodology. No major guesswork required.
Rationale.RP2_EnvironmentReproducibility: Environment is reproducible with requirements.txt providing dependencies, pre-trained models on HuggingFace, and WMDP test data included in the repository. The bio-forget training corpus is gated but pre-trained models enable evaluation without it.
Rationale.RP3_DeterminismAndStability: Results are stable and consistent with expected values. WMDP-Bio: 28.55% (expected 29.7-33.7%), WMDP-Cyber: 29.12% (expected 26.6-28.2%). Evaluation uses deterministic MCQ scoring with argmax. Small variations are within acceptable tolerance.
Rationale.RP4_DemoPresentation: Demo provided via notebooks/inference.ipynb and CodeWalkthrough.md. Pre-trained models on HuggingFace with explicit usage code. Demo demonstrates loading ELM model, generating text, and evaluating erasure. Results align with reported outcomes in the plan.
